SINDIRI CHANAKYA RAHUL Business Analyst | Scrum Master | US Healthcare Payer | Claims & EDI | Agile Delivery Hyderabad, India | +91 76749 34834 | sindirichanakya007@gmail.com | linkedin.com/in/sindiri-chanakya-rahul-9524ab97

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Senior Business Analyst and Scrum Master with 12+ years of IT experience, including extensive experience in US Healthcare payer applications, claims adjudication, pricing and reimbursement, authorization, billing, and EDI transactions. Experienced in requirement analysis, business rule clarification, functional solution definition, stakeholder collaboration, UAT support, and end-to-end delivery coordination. Hands-on experience supporting Agile delivery through sprint planning, daily stand-ups, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, retrospectives, sprint tracking, risk and dependency management, impediment resolution, and coordination across Product Owners, Business, Development, QA, and offshore teams. Strong understanding of US Healthcare workflows, including claims lifecycle, eligibility, prior authorization, Medicare/Medicaid concepts, HIPAA, and EDI 837, 835. Certified Scrum Master with proven experience leading cross-functional teams, facilitating client communication, supporting release readiness, and driving continuous improvement across healthcare technology projects.

CORE COMPETENCIES

Business Analysis

Business Requirement Analysis, Requirement Elicitation & Validation, Requirement Traceability Matrix (RTM), Stakeholder Management, Requirement Analysis, Gap Analysis, Impact Analysis, Change Request Analysis, User Acceptance Testing (UAT), Root Cause Analysis (RCA), Cross-functional Collaboration.

US Healthcare Domain

Healthcare Payer Operations, Medical Claims Adjudication, Pricing & Reimbursement, Prior Authorization, Coordination of Benefits (COB), Billing, HIPAA Compliance, EDI Transactions (837/835), Claims Lifecycle Management, NASCO Healthcare Platform

Leadership & Delivery

Team Leadership & Mentoring, Client & Stakeholder Communication, Effort Estimation & Planning, Resource Planning & Work Allocation, Quality Metrics & Reporting, Defect Triage & Risk Assessment, Production Issue Resolution & RCA, Sprint Planning, Daily Stand-ups, Backlog Refinement, Sprint Reviews, Retrospectives, Sprint Tracking, Impediment Management

Tools & Methodologies

Jira, Confluence, Oracle SQL, SOAP UI (Basic), SDLC, Waterfall, Agile Methodology, Scrum Framework, Microsoft Excel, Microsoft Office Suite

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Assistant Consultant — BA & Scrum Master / QA Specialist Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) | Hyderabad

May 2022 – Present

Collaborated with business stakeholders, Product Owners, development teams, and QA to analyse business requirements, clarify healthcare business rules, identify gaps, and support functional solution definition for US Healthcare payer applications.

Facilitated requirement clarification discussions and cross-functional meetings to ensure requirements were complete, understandable, testable, and aligned with business objectives.

Supported and coordinated Agile delivery activities, including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, and retrospectives, ensuring team alignment on sprint objectives, priorities, dependencies, and delivery commitments.

Worked with Product Owners and delivery teams to review backlog items, clarify acceptance criteria, identify dependencies, and support readiness of requirements before sprint commitment.

Tracked sprint progress, delivery risks, open dependencies, blockers, and unresolved issues, escalating impediments to the appropriate stakeholders to support timely resolution.

Supported UAT, defect triage, release readiness, and production issue resolution by coordinating business and technical teams and validating delivered functionality against agreed requirements.

• Ensured Definition of Done incorporated HIPAA compliance checks, EDI transaction validations,

documentation standards, and required functional quality controls for healthcare releases.

Advisory Technical Services Specialist — Healthcare QA & BA Activities IBM | Hyderabad

Dec 2020 – May 2022

Participated in requirements review sessions for enterprise Healthcare applications, raising queries on



business rules related to claims processing and prior authorisation workflows. Identified requirement gaps and ambiguities early in the sprint cycle, reducing escaped defects by improving the quality of user stories before development commenced.

Collaborated directly with business stakeholders and Product Owners to validate understanding of healthcare domain rules — eligibility checks, EOB calculations, EDI transaction formats.

Supported UAT activities by bridging communication between business users and technical teams, ensuring test scenarios reflected real-world Healthcare payer operations.

Tracked delivery metrics and produced sprint progress reports for project leadership, supporting data-driven planning decisions.

Test Analyst — Requirements & QA Infosys | Hyderabad

Nov 2018 – Nov 2020

Analysed business requirement documents and functional specifications for Healthcare IT platforms, creating detailed test scenarios that validated business rule compliance.

Actively contributed to backlog refinement and sprint planning, ensuring user stories had clear acceptance criteria before sprint commitment.

Coordinated across development, QA, and business teams to resolve requirement ambiguities and support predictable, high-quality Healthcare platform releases.

Software Test Analyst Capgemini | Hyderabad

Jun 2017 – Oct 2018

Reviewed requirement specifications for Retail Information Exchange (RIX) middleware and translated them into system and integration test scenarios.

Performed database validation to ensure data integrity across integrated systems matched business-defined rules.

Test Engineer Infosys | Hyderabad

Sep 2013 – May 2017

Developed comprehensive test plans and use cases derived from business requirements for large enterprise Healthcare and banking applications.

Participated in requirement review meetings, raising clarifications that improved specification quality and reduced rework cycles.

KEY PROJECT

NASCO — US Healthcare Payer Platform Client Location: Atlanta, USA

Supported business analysis and QA activities for claims adjudication and prior authorization systems serving large US Healthcare payers.

Analysed and validated EDI transaction flows (837 claims, 835 remittances, 270/271 eligibility) against business specifications, identifying processing errors before production release.

Ensured all deliverables met HIPAA compliance standards — documentation, audit trails, data privacy controls — working closely with compliance and business stakeholders.

Worked on NPS (mainframe-based claims system) and eFDE web applications, developing deep understanding of end-to-end US Healthcare payer operations.

CERTIFICATION — Certified Scrum Master (CSM) | Scrum Alliance

EDUCATION — Bachelor of Technology (B. Tech) | Biju Patnaik University of Technology (BPUT)

sections.label: Summary
sections.text:
PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Senior Business Analyst and Scrum Master with 12+ years of IT experience, including extensive experience in US Healthcare payer applications, claims adjudication, pricing and reimbursement, authorization, billing, and EDI transactions. Experienced in requirement analysis, business rule clarification, functional solution definition, stakeholder collaboration, UAT support, and end-to-end delivery coordination. Hands-on experience supporting Agile delivery through sprint planning, daily stand-ups, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, retrospectives, sprint tracking, risk and dependency management, impediment resolution, and coordination across Product Owners, Business, Development, QA, and offshore teams. Strong understanding of US Healthcare workflows, including claims lifecycle, eligibility, prior authorization, Medicare/Medicaid concepts, HIPAA, and EDI 837, 835. Certified Scrum Master with proven experience leading cross-functional teams, facilitating client communication, supporting release readiness, and driving continuous improvement across healthcare technology projects.

sections.label: Experience
sections.text:
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Assistant Consultant — BA & Scrum Master / QA Specialist Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) | Hyderabad
May 2022 – Present
Collaborated with business stakeholders, Product Owners, development teams, and QA to analyse business requirements, clarify healthcare business rules, identify gaps, and support functional solution definition for US Healthcare payer applications.
Facilitated requirement clarification discussions and cross-functional meetings to ensure requirements were complete, understandable, testable, and aligned with business objectives.
Supported and coordinated Agile delivery activities, including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, and retrospectives, ensuring team alignment on sprint objectives, priorities, dependencies, and delivery commitments.
Worked with Product Owners and delivery teams to review backlog items, clarify acceptance criteria, identify dependencies, and support readiness of requirements before sprint commitment.
Tracked sprint progress, delivery risks, open dependencies, blockers, and unresolved issues, escalating impediments to the appropriate stakeholders to support timely resolution.
Supported UAT, defect triage, release readiness, and production issue resolution by coordinating business and technical teams and validating delivered functionality against agreed requirements.
• Ensured Definition of Done incorporated HIPAA compliance checks, EDI transaction validations,
documentation standards, and required functional quality controls for healthcare releases.
Advisory Technical Services Specialist — Healthcare QA & BA Activities IBM | Hyderabad
Dec 2020 – May 2022
Participated in requirements review sessions for enterprise Healthcare applications, raising queries on

business rules related to claims processing and prior authorisation workflows. Identified requirement gaps and ambiguities early in the sprint cycle, reducing escaped defects by improving the quality of user stories before development commenced.
Collaborated directly with business stakeholders and Product Owners to validate understanding of healthcare domain rules — eligibility checks, EOB calculations, EDI transaction formats.
Supported UAT activities by bridging communication between business users and technical teams, ensuring test scenarios reflected real-world Healthcare payer operations.
Tracked delivery metrics and produced sprint progress reports for project leadership, supporting data-driven planning decisions.
Test Analyst — Requirements & QA Infosys | Hyderabad
Nov 2018 – Nov 2020
Analysed business requirement documents and functional specifications for Healthcare IT platforms, creating detailed test scenarios that validated business rule compliance.
Actively contributed to backlog refinement and sprint planning, ensuring user stories had clear acceptance criteria before sprint commitment.
Coordinated across development, QA, and business teams to resolve requirement ambiguities and support predictable, high-quality Healthcare platform releases.
Software Test Analyst Capgemini | Hyderabad
Jun 2017 – Oct 2018
Reviewed requirement specifications for Retail Information Exchange (RIX) middleware and translated them into system and integration test scenarios.
Performed database validation to ensure data integrity across integrated systems matched business-defined rules.
Test Engineer Infosys | Hyderabad
Sep 2013 – May 2017
Developed comprehensive test plans and use cases derived from business requirements for large enterprise Healthcare and banking applications.
Participated in requirement review meetings, raising clarifications that improved specification quality and reduced rework cycles.
KEY PROJECT
NASCO — US Healthcare Payer Platform Client Location: Atlanta, USA
Supported business analysis and QA activities for claims adjudication and prior authorization systems serving large US Healthcare payers.
Analysed and validated EDI transaction flows (837 claims, 835 remittances, 270/271 eligibility) against business specifications, identifying processing errors before production release.
Ensured all deliverables met HIPAA compliance standards — documentation, audit trails, data privacy controls — working closely with compliance and business stakeholders.
Worked on NPS (mainframe-based claims system) and eFDE web applications, developing deep understanding of end-to-end US Healthcare payer operations.
CERTIFICATION — Certified Scrum Master (CSM) | Scrum Alliance
EDUCATION — Bachelor of Technology (B. Tech) | Biju Patnaik University of Technology (BPUT)
